description:
Just like the first season, Liella no Uta 2 is a weekly animated music segment shown with each Love Live! Superstar!! Season 2 episode exclusively on the NHK Educational TV (NHK E) broadcast of the TV anime. These shorts will later be released across all 6 volumes of the Blu-ray/DVD releases of Love Live! Superstar!! 2.

The list of released animations included in this entry are as follows:
#1) Dreamer Coaster (Shibuya Kanon)
#2) Dreamer Coaster (Sakurakouji Kinako)
#3) Endless Circuit (Tang Keke)
#4) Endless Circuit (Heanna Sumire)
#5) Meikyuu Sanka (Hazuki Ren)
#6) Meikyuu Sanka (Onitsuka Natsumi)
#7) Prime Adventure (Liella!)
#8) Parade wa Itsumo (Yoneme Mei)
#9) Parade wa Itsumo (Wakana Shiki)
#10) Kakeru Merry-Go-Round (Arashi Chisato)
#11) Kakeru Merry-Go-Round (Shibuya Kanon)
#12) Time to go (Liella!)
